爱莎贝儿-163CM-L 粉肤 RAHC045 望月恵美Mochizuki Emi-阿姨与我的暧昧时刻
家庭聚会上，阿姨悄悄坐到我旁边，身体紧贴着我。
她摸着我的腿，我脸一红，呼吸都乱了，心里小鹿乱撞~
阿姨似乎是喝多了，一直搂着我，脸贴在我胸口。
她脸红红的贴着我摸着我的头发，我感受到了她的温度~
我全身发热，心跳得像打鼓，不知该躲还是留。
她推着我进了隔壁的房间~
身型:163CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-163CM-L Pink RAHC045 Mochizuki Emi-My Aunt's Ambiguous Moment
At a family gathering, my aunt quietly sat down next to me, her body pressed close to mine.
She touched my leg, and my face flushed, my breathing became erratic, and my heart pounded.
My aunt seemed to have had a few drinks; she kept holding me, her face pressed against my chest.
Her face was flushed as she touched my hair, and I could feel her warmth.
My whole body felt hot, my heart pounded like a drum, and I didn't know whether to stay or leave.
She pushed me into the next room.
Body type: 163CM-L with Pink skin tone.
